$comment: SteelScope source registry. Add a source by appending an entry. Only enable sources that publish a public RSS/Atom feed or an official API whose terms allow automated access. SteelScope stores headlines, short publisher excerpts and links only - never full article text - and always links to the original article. 'verified' is set to true by a maintainer after checking the feed and its terms; per-run health is recorded in data/meta.json.

sources.name: Press Information Bureau (Govt. of India)
sources.notes: Official Government of India press releases, including Ministry of Steel announcements. Feed covers all ministries; the relevance filter keeps steel-related releases.

sources.name: The Economic Times
sources.notes: Public RSS for the Metals & Mining section. ET RSS is offered for personal/feed-reader use; headlines + links only.

sources.name: The Economic Times
sources.notes: Steel section RSS. Feed ID to be confirmed on first run (see source health).

sources.name: Business Standard
sources.notes: Public RSS. Many full articles are paywalled; SteelScope uses only feed metadata and links out.

sources.name: Business Standard
sources.notes: Public RSS; feed metadata only.

sources.notes: Public section RSS.

sources.notes: Public section RSS (policy, trade, commodities).

sources.name: MINING.COM
sources.notes: Public WordPress feed; strong iron ore / coking coal / steel coverage.

sources.name: World Steel Association
sources.notes: Official industry body. Monthly production statistics and short-range outlooks.

sources.name: Google News: India steel industry
sources.notes: Discovery feed. Each item is attributed to the original publisher via the feed's <source> element and links to that publisher's article. Review Google News terms before commercial use.

sources.notes: Discovery feed for company announcements and results.

sources.notes: Discovery feed for policy, BIS standards and trade remedies.

sources.name: Google News: India iron ore and coking coal

sources.name: Google News: global steel industry
sources.notes: Discovery feed for global coverage.

sources.name: Google News: China, Europe and US steel

sources.name: Google News: green steel and raw materials
sources.notes: Discovery feed for decarbonisation and commodity coverage.

sources.name: SteelOrbis
sources.notes: Most news and all prices are subscriber-only. No public feed confirmed. Enable only with a licensed feed/API.

sources.name: BigMint (formerly SteelMint)
sources.notes: Price assessments are licensed data. Requires a commercial data agreement; do not scrape.

sources.name: Fastmarkets
sources.notes: Paywalled; prices are licensed benchmarks. Requires licence.

sources.name: Argus Media
sources.notes: Licensed price reporting agency. Free news pages exist but no feed for automated reuse is confirmed.

sources.name: S&P Global Commodity Insights
sources.notes: Platts assessments are licensed. Requires a commercial agreement.

sources.name: Reuters
sources.notes: Reuters discontinued public RSS feeds. Reuters stories may still surface via discovery feeds with attribution; direct ingestion needs a Reuters licence.

sources.name: SteelRadar
sources.notes: Feed availability and terms not yet evaluated.
